description: Bring screens from a Figma file into a Figma design project, the way “Add your Figma design” in layernote does: each frame becomes a screen the team can comment on. Name the frames (by name or id from list_figma_frames, up to 50), or leave them out for the whole file. A named frame the project already has is brought up to date when Figma changed it, and keeps its comments. One Figma file per project. layernote uses the user’s own Figma connection in layernote; when it is missing, the answer says how the user connects it. The pictures appear a few seconds after. Only import when the user asks.

fileUrl.description: The Figma file’s link, as Figma copies it (File, Copy link)

frames.description: The frames to bring in, by name or Figma node id. Left out: every frame in the file

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

name: import_figma_frames
title: Import frames from Figma
